measured.authority: The live native tool schema wins over this file: where they differ, follow the live schema and disclose the difference.

detect.why: innermost host first: a nested host inherits its launcher's variables
detect.exact_names_only: Never match a prefix: Codex plugin variables (CODEX_COMPANION_*) are set in Claude Code and Grok sessions.

claude.name: Claude Code
claude.collect: foreground calls block and multiple foreground Agent calls in one turn run concurrently without yielding; if backgrounded, completion notifications re-enter the parent as new turns (do not poll)
claude.hint: Use Agent (omit isolation and resume): subagent_type="general-purpose" for fresh workers, subagent_type="fork" for forked reviews; use run_in_background=false (multiple foreground calls in one turn run concurrently); prefix every Bash command with cd "<WORKTREE>" &&.

codex.name: Codex
codex.collect: wait_agent with timeout_ms: 120000, not short polls
codex.hint: Use spawn_agent: fork_turns="none" for fresh workers (default on 0.171.0 is "all"), fork_turns="all" for forked reviews; at most 3 concurrent workers (4 slots include the parent); wait with wait_agent timeout_ms=120000 (no short polls); set explicit workdir on every shell command.

grok.name: Grok Build
grok.collect: multiple foreground spawn_subagent(background=false) calls in one turn run concurrently (up to 10 min); if background=true, collect with get_command_or_subagent_output using all task ids and timeout_ms: 120000
grok.hint: Use spawn_subagent with cwd="<WORKTREE>", background=false, and omit resume_from and isolation="worktree" (no native fork on Grok: use the fresh brief with inline conversation context); multiple foreground calls in one turn run concurrently.

cursor.name: Cursor
cursor.collect: multiple foreground Task(run_in_background=false) calls in one turn run concurrently without yielding; if backgrounded, completion notifications arrive after turn end (do not poll)
cursor.hint: Use Task with subagent_type="generalPurpose" (omit environment="cloud"): omit resume for fresh workers, resume="self" for forked reviews; use run_in_background=false (multiple foreground calls in one turn run concurrently); set working_directory on every shell call and use absolute file paths.

opencode.name: OpenCode
opencode.collect: background fan-out requires OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKGROUND_SUBAGENTS=true in a persistent TUI; otherwise run serially
opencode.hint: Use task without task_id and set workdir on every bash call; background fan-out requires a persistent TUI with OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKGROUND_SUBAGENTS=true (otherwise run serially).
